outcome: Evaluation of conservative management for postpartum uterine dehiscence
cohort: Three women diagnosed by ultrasound with a dehiscent scar postpartum after cesarean section.
finding: The study presents three cases of postpartum uterine dehiscence after cesarean section that were managed conservatively with regular follow-up.
mod_finding: Uterine dehiscence was observed postpartum after cesarean section.
